purpose: Public-safe proof card for AML Layer 1 evidence wiring. It explains what was verified, where the evidence contract lives, and what authority the system still does not have.
privacy_boundary: Repository-relative docs and public-safe summaries only. No local machine paths, secrets, private infrastructure, account-level details, employer data, or client data.
reading_rule: Every visible claim should resolve to a contract doc, test receipt, artifact contract, or explicit boundary.
visible_claims: AML status can only be treated as evidence-backed when stub is false, counts exist, source metadata exists, rules are loaded, and freshness checks pass.
Planning/advisor gate outputs carry proposal_clean and may_execute fields, with may_execute remaining false on every branch.
Canonical local proof artifacts are defined as JSON, Markdown, latest aliases, and SHA-256 sidecars under the vault operations log pattern.
Mission Control UI surfaces evidence status, blockers, source freshness, proof artifact status, artifact path, proof hash, and artifact age.
The public page is a proof surface, not an operational compliance product.
